description: Source code for Ginkgo's default test reporter, implementing suite and spec reporting with detailed formatting, including timeline, failures, and goroutine info.

classes.name: DefaultReporter
classes.description: Main struct implementing the reporting interface, handling suite and spec reporting, formatting, and output control.

methods.name: SuiteWillBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs initial suite info based on verbosity.

methods.name: SuiteDidEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test suite, summarizes failures and overall results.

methods.name: WillRun
methods.description: Prepares to run a specific test, outputs info if verbosity is high.

methods.name: DidRun
methods.description: Outputs detailed info after a test completes, including status, failures, timeline, and goroutines.

methods.name: EmitFailure
methods.description: Outputs a failure message for a specific test.

methods.name: EmitProgressReport
methods.description: Outputs progress updates during test execution.

methods.name: EmitReportEntry
methods.description: Outputs a report entry with name, location, and optional string representation.

methods.name: EmitSpecEvent
methods.description: Outputs specific test events like start, end, retry, or repeat.
